preconditions.description: t is an integer between 1 and 1000 inclusive, representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 1000 for n in [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]])
preconditions.description: Each test case's n is an integer between 1 and 1000 inclusive, representing half the array size.

preconditions.expression: all(len(a) == 2 * int(n) for n, a in zip([int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]], [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2]]))
preconditions.description: Each test case's array a has exactly 2n elements.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(num) <= 10**6 for num in [int(num) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2] for num in line.split()])
preconditions.description: Each element in a is a positive integer between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_line.strip() in ['YES', 'NO'] for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines() if stdout_line.strip() != '')
postconditions.description: For each test case, the first line of output is either 'YES' or 'NO', indicating feasibility.

postconditions.expression: all('YES' in stdout_line for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines() if 'YES' in stdout_line) == all('NO' in stdout_line for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines() if 'NO' in stdout_line)
postconditions.description: The output is consistent: 'YES' or 'NO' is printed exactly once per test case.

postconditions.expression: all('YES' in stdout_line and any('x' in line.lower() for line in stdout.splitlines()[i+1:i+1+n+1]) for i, stdout_line in enumerate(stdout.splitlines()) if stdout_line.strip() == 'YES')
postconditions.description: If 'YES' is printed for a test case, the next line contains the initial x, followed by n lines describing operations.

postconditions.expression: all('YES' in stdout_line and all(len(line.split()) == 2 for line in stdout.splitlines()[i+2:i+2+n]) for i, stdout_line in enumerate(stdout.splitlines()) if stdout_line.strip() == 'YES')
postconditions.description: If 'YES' is printed, each of the n following lines contains exactly two integers representing the pair removed in each operation.

postconditions.expression: all('YES' in stdout_line and all(int(a) + int(b) == x for x, a, b in zip([int(stdout.splitlines()[i+1].strip()) for i, line in enumerate(stdout.splitlines()) if line.strip() == 'YES'], [int(num) for line in stdout.splitlines()[i+2:i+2+n] for num in line.split()])) for i, stdout_line in enumerate(stdout.splitlines()) if stdout_line.strip() == 'YES')
postconditions.description: For each operation, the sum of the two removed numbers equals the current x (initially chosen x, then updated to the max of the pair).

postconditions.expression: all('YES' in stdout_line and all(int(a) + int(b) == x and max(int(a), int(b)) == next_x for x, a, b, next_x in zip([int(stdout.splitlines()[i+1].strip())], [int(num) for line in stdout.splitlines()[i+2:i+2+n] for num in line.split()], [int(stdout.splitlines()[i+1].strip())], [int(stdout.splitlines()[i+2+j].strip().split()[0]) + int(stdout.splitlines()[i+2+j].strip().split()[1]) for j in range(n)])) for i, stdout_line in enumerate(stdout.splitlines()) if stdout_line.strip() == 'YES')
postconditions.description: The x is updated to the maximum of the two removed numbers in each operation.

postconditions.expression: all('YES' in stdout_line and all(int(a) in a_initial and int(b) in a_initial for a, b, a_initial in zip([int(num) for line in stdout.splitlines()[i+2:i+2+n] for num in line.split()], [int(num) for line in stdout.splitlines()[i+2:i+2+n] for num in line.split()], [int(num) for num in stdin.splitlines()[i+2].split()])) for i, stdout_line in enumerate(stdout.splitlines()) if stdout_line.strip() == 'YES')
postconditions.description: The pairs removed in operations are elements from the original array a.

postconditions.expression: all('YES' in stdout_line and len(set([int(num) for num in stdin.splitlines()[i+2].split()])) == 2 * int(n) for i, stdout_line in enumerate(stdout.splitlines()) if stdout_line.strip() == 'YES')
postconditions.description: All elements of the original array are removed exactly once across all operations.
